indices.proven_in: token-free-plan evidence live-probe.json (شاخص كل identity match)

policy.identical_duplicate_policy: identical duplicate rows are deduplicated and counted
policy.conflict_policy: any primary/secondary date disagreement or positive-volume stock date outside both indices is a CONFLICT; operations depending on that window halt; nothing is averaged or hidden
policy.watermark_policy: LastPossibleDeven: only agreement of the first two semicolon components yields a completion watermark; semantics undocumented
policy.weekend_policy: Thursday/Friday absence is advisory only; sessions are never generated
policy.future_date_policy: dates after the Tehran-local reference day are rejected
policy.coverage_policy: window is covered only if index history reaches window_start and is not behind the completion watermark; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE

limitations: completeness_certified=false: both indices come from one provider and are not independent; agreement does not certify that every market session is present.
LastPossibleDeven component semantics are not officially documented; only component agreement is used.
Identity endpoint rows carry dEven=0; they are used for identity only, never for session dates.
This dataset is not an NSCStart equivalent; no NSCEnd field is fabricated.
No future sessions are predicted; Thursday/Friday patterns are advisory only and never generate sessions.
Days absent from all sources are NO_POSITIVE_EVIDENCE, never definite market closure.
Whether the identity endpoint enumerates non-TSE indices was not established.
